subject: MarketLane: short-term capacity uplift + fallback corridor
messages:
From: Santiago Ruiz <santiago.ruiz@marketlane.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity uplift ask + short-term protection while we conclude side-by-side

Olga —

Quick note from our side: we’ve entered a side-by-side evaluation with AstraServe for part of our realtime inference tier. They’ve proposed an aggressive pricing model and are offering a pilot with guaranteed peak capacity.

Before we move anything, we want to give Redwood a shot at a short-term uplift + protection that lets us continue production with you while we finish the eval. High-level ask:
- Additional dedicated capacity for up to 250k tokens/day sustained for 90 days (from go-live of uplift).
- A temporary uplift price (effective for the first 3 months) to bridge the unit-cost delta — looking for something in the 20–35% off typical hosted unit price.
- A short “fallback corridor” clause: if by day 60 we decide to transition, we want the ability to pause new scaling commitments with a 30-day notice and predictable de-provisioning.

We’re willing to sign a time-boxed amendment quickly if the terms are reasonable. Attached is our internal throughput readout from last week (sample traces + QPS profile). Can we get a scoping plan + preliminary term-sheet by EOD Wednesday our time? Priya Shah (legal) looped in on CC for the fallback clause.

Thanks —
Santiago
Chief Product Officer
MarketLane

Attachments: marketlane_throughput_report_v2.pdf (pdf, 1.8MB)

Subject: Re: Capacity uplift ask + short-term protection while we conclude side-by-side

Santiago —

Thanks for the clarity and the trace bundle — appreciate the fast turnaround. We can support a time-boxed uplift and a fallback corridor but there are a few moving parts to align (pricing, Dedicated pool reservation, and a short benchmark window to validate p95 + token throughput under your workload).

Proposed immediate steps (mutual action plan):
1) Redwood runs a 48–72 hour smoke + soak test with your sample traces next week (we’ll reserve a dedicated pool).
2) Redwood to provide a short-term term-sheet covering a 90-day uplift with a 3-month temporary discount window; requires an amendment signature to commit capacity.
3) Include fallback corridor language that supports a 30-day deprovisioning path and data-residency confirmation.

We’ll draft the term-sheet and a scoped test plan and get it to you by Wed EOD PT. Draft attached for quick review — it’s a placeholder until Ben confirms the technical schedule.

I’ll be your main point for contract/terms — looping Karthik for pricing and Ben for ops.

Olga

Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity uplift ask + short-term protection while we conclude side-by-side

Santiago / team —

Thanks — quick heads up on commercial framing from our side. To move fast we can offer the following conditional structure:

- Committed uplift: +250k tokens/day for 90 days (Committed Add-on).
- Promotional price: 30% off hosted per-token price applied to uplifted volumes for the first 3 months from amendment effective date.
- Billing: invoice monthly; promotional credit applied at invoice level.
- Conditions: promo is conditional on (a) signed amendment within 7 business days of acceptance, (b) completion of the 48–72h smoke test and confirmation of p95 baseline not exceeding 150ms for the sampling window.
- Fallback corridor: 30-day deprovisioning notice; deprovisioning fees limited to 10% of remaining committed uplift value if MarketLane elects to pause after day 60.

I’m attaching an editable amendment draft for legal to review — highlights show the billing waterfall and the fallback clause. Open to tighten the SLA numbers depending on Ben’s test plan.

Karthik
Director, Commercials — Redwood Inference

Attachments: amendment-draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity uplift ask + short-term protection while we conclude side-by-side

All —

Technical note on the smoke/soak test and capacity reservation:
- We need a 48–72 hour window to run a side-by-side with MarketLane traces (best-effort reproduction of your QPS cycle). We’ll run the test in our Dedicated pool in us-west-2.
- Pre-checks: ensure trace anonymization (no PII) and provide a single traffic replay file (max 4GB).
- Acceptance criteria (suggested): sustained p95 <= 150ms, dropped-requests < 0.1%, KV cache hit > 85% for prefix cache window.
- Ops ask: reserve a Dedicated pool of 2 x A100-equivalent for the window; cost to reserve will be amortized into the uplift amendment as a one-time pool reservation fee (we’ll estimate in the term-sheet).
- Schedule: propose Wed 23 Jun 14:00–18:00 PT / Thu 24 Jun 02:00–06:00 UTC as primary window; alternative Fri 25 Jun 09:00–13:00 PT.

I’ve attached a short test plan with the technical steps and who needs to be on the call. Ben
Principal Engineer, Platform — Redwood Inference

Attachments: throughput-smoke-test-plan.md (md, stub)

Thanks — Wed 23 14:00 PT works for us for the smoke test. We’ll send the anonymized replay file tonight. A couple of asks from legal/ops:
- Need written confirmation that data residency for the uplift window remains in us-west-2 and that logs/audit trails for the test are retained for 90 days.
- Regarding the fallback corridor, Priya (CC) wants the deprovisioning fees and timeline explicitly stated in the amendment and prefers a capped-cost approach rather than a percentage.

Priya: happy to coordinate legal redlines after we get Karthik’s draft. If you can make the amendment drafter-friendly (track changes/word doc) that helps.

We’ll join Wed at 14:00 and can have Platform and Legal on the bridge.

—Santiago
